name: Angelique Ashby

items.text: In August 2022, Ashby's opponent Dave Jones sued over her ballot title "Councilmember/Women's Advocate." A judge ruled she hadn't shown it was a primary vocation distinct from her council work. She called the challenge petty and the ruling disappointing. She ran as "City Councilwoman," and the Secretary of State's office had accepted her designation.
items.why: A court sided with her opponent on a ballot-title dispute, but made no finding of lying or abuse, so it has no clear bearing on the record-honesty criterion (6).

for_review: The owner-sites search (alexjoneslive.com, stewpeters.com, ryandawson.org, infowars.com) returned nothing about Ashby. I read the Sacramento Bee story via AOL but not the court order itself. An opponent's spokesman said she claimed to be a public defender in her 2016 mayoral run. Ashby's Senate bio says she worked in the public defender's office while in law school. I did not read the 2016 Bee editorial or any response from her. If that claim were shown by her own words to be false, it could count as medium-weight lying about her record. Check it before relying on it.
